exposure: Two groups: fetuses of diabetic mothers (DM) and fetuses of non-diabetic mothers (NDM)
Maternal diabetes status (diabetic mothers vs. non-diabetic mothers)
cohort: Fetuses of diabetic mothers (N = 532) and non-diabetic mothers (N = 103) at a mean gestational age of 24 weeks
finding: Fetuses of diabetic mothers had significantly larger semilunar valve diameter, higher left ventricular (LV) output, higher combined cardiac output (adjusted for fetal weight), and lower right ventricle/left ventricle ratio compared to fetuses of non-diabetic mothers.
mod_finding: C-section delivery occurred in 66% of diabetic mothers (DM) vs. 35% of non-diabetic mothers (NDM).
